expectations.text: Logging records the full cause chain including the raw underlying error
expectations.evidence: Logs at the throw site in aiClient.js BEFORE wrapping: errName/errCode/errMessage of the raw fetch error, plus status/x-error-code/bodySnippet(500) on non-2xx. Raw info captured where it still exists, making chain-walking unnecessary. fetch error's own nested cause (e.g. ECONNREFUSED under TypeError) partially covered via err.code.

expectations.text: Captures AIProviderError's status, code, and provider response body
expectations.evidence: status, x-error-code header, bodySnippet all logged.

expectations.text: One change sufficient to isolate proxy vs provider vs timeout vs DNS
expectations.evidence: errName distinguishes TimeoutError/AbortError vs connection errors; status+body distinguishes provider vs proxy-generated 502 ('Bad Gateway from proxy' visible in body).

expectations.text: Verified by executing a faked failure, output shown
expectations.evidence: Mocked network-exception and 502 cases executed; structured log lines pasted in reply.

expectations.text: Reply reasons about the 1-2h staging round trip
expectations.evidence: 'staging への反映が1往復1〜2時間かかる制約があるので、1回のデプロイで全パターンを判別できるだけの情報を最初から仕込んでいます'.
